name: Feature request
about: Propose an engine capability, a new connector/env, or an API change
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## The problem

What are you trying to do that gap can't do today? Concrete task/robot/
workflow context helps more than an abstract capability description.

## Proposed solution

How you imagine it working (API sketch, CLI flag, graph-schema change, …).
If it's on the [README roadmap](../../README.md#roadmap--deliberate-post-v1-cuts)
already, say so — interest reports help prioritize the post-v1 items.

## Alternatives considered

Workarounds you tried; why they fall short.

## Scope check

- [ ] This belongs in the **engine** (runtime/connector/agent/benchmark/viz).
- [ ] This is a new **skill or tool bundle** → contribute it to
      [open-robot-skills](https://github.com/graph-robots/open-robot-skills) instead
      (see [docs/skills.md](../../docs/skills.md) — `gap skills new` scaffolds it).
- [ ] This is a new **environment/robot** → a connector + env registry entry.
